scene_description.environment: Interior architectural scene based on the reference image
scene_description.objective: Apply the requested interior design transformation
scene_description.architectural_preservation: Preserve the original spatial geometry, architectural layout, proportions, openings and structural elements
scene_description.furniture: Use furniture appropriate to the selected design style and room function
scene_description.decoration: Add cohesive decorative elements without changing the original framing

style.color_palette: Balanced neutral colors and natural tones

lighting.shadows: Realistic soft shadows and contact shadows
lighting.time_of_day: Consistent with the reference image unless a lighting change is requested

materials.flooring: Realistic material with accurate surface texture
materials.walls: High-quality finishes appropriate to the design
materials.wood: Natural grain and physically plausible finish
materials.stone: Detailed natural veining and realistic reflectivity
materials.fabrics: Natural fibers with realistic surface details

camera.preservation_rule: The point of view, camera height, perspective and framing are identical to the original image and must not be changed.
camera.camera_position: Exactly identical to the reference image
camera.camera_height: Exactly identical to the reference image
camera.viewing_angle: Exactly identical to the reference image
camera.focal_length: Preserve the apparent original focal length
camera.framing: Exactly identical to the reference image

composition.vanishing_points: Preserve the original perspective vanishing points
composition.visual_balance: Integrate design elements without altering the camera composition

resolution.physical_accuracy: Realistic material, light and shadow behavior

people.integration: Correct scale, lighting and contact shadows
people.existing_subjects: Preserve existing subjects unless removal is requested

pets.integration: Natural placement, realistic anatomy and coherent lighting
pets.existing_subjects: Preserve existing subjects unless removal is requested
